programme_title: Shanghai Jiao Tong University - International Graduate Scholarships (CGS, SGS, SJTU)
funding_summary: The guide gives no stipend amounts. It says the SJTU Scholarship, Tuition Waiver Scholarship and School/College Scholarships may cover full or partial tuition, and accommodation subsidies depend on the scholarship. Details are on the application website.
summary: Graduate admissions for non-Chinese citizens with a valid ordinary passport, with scholarships by level. Doctoral: SJTU Fellowship, Chinese Government Scholarship (CGS), Shanghai Government Scholarship (SGS) and SJTU Scholarship. Master's: CGS, SGS, SJTU Scholarship, SJTU Tuition Waiver Scholarship and School/College Scholarships. Scholarship applicants must be under 40 (doctoral) or under 35 (master's) and must not hold other scholarship support. Applicants choose one channel only: Type B through SJTU (agency code 10248; those not recommended for CGS are automatically considered for other scholarships), or Type A through a Chinese embassy or consulate in the home country (typically November to April depending on the country), plus the SJTU online application in both cases. The application fee is RMB 800, non-refundable.
route_name: Online application at apply.sjtu.edu.cn (Type B) or via embassy (Type A)
deadline_source_text: CGS first round 15 December 2025; CGS final round 15 February 2026; SGS and SJTU Scholarship 31 March 2026; self-supported applications 31 May 2026 (opened 15 October 2025). All Beijing Time, no hour stated.

programme_title: Zhejiang University - Doctoral Scholarship Routes for International Applicants
funding_summary: The guide lists scholarship routes but states no amounts or coverage: CSC Type B (Chinese University Program), CSC Type A (Bilateral Program), China-ASEAN Oceanic Scholarship, China Studies Program Ph.D. in China Fellowship, Zhejiang Government Scholarship, ZJE Hai Scholarship, International School of Medicine Scholarship, Optical Science and Engineering Scholarship, and self-funded places.
summary: Doctoral application guide for non-Chinese citizens holding an ordinary foreign passport, with a master's degree, generally under 40 (flexible for healthy applicants with working experience and high academic ability), and a passport valid beyond 1 March 2027. Some routes are restricted: the China Studies fellowship is for humanities and social science programmes, the China-ASEAN scholarship for Ocean College programmes, the Medicine scholarship for the International School of Medicine and the Optical scholarship for the College of Optical Science and Engineering. A personal statement of at least 1,500 words and two recommendation letters are required, plus a supervisor provisional acceptance form for some programmes. The application fee is RMB 800, non-refundable, and applications without the fee paid by the deadline are invalid. Language thresholds are in a separate ZJU document not read here.
route_name: Online application on the ZJU admissions portal
deadline_source_text: 2026 deadlines (Beijing Time): CSC Type B 31 December 2025; China-ASEAN Oceanic Scholarship 31 May 2026; China Studies fellowship, Zhejiang Government Scholarship, ZJE Hai, Medicine, Optical and self-funded 28 February 2026; CSC Type A has no ZJU date (ask your country's dispatch department).

funder_name: China Scholarship Council, Ministry of Education and State Oceanic Administration
funding_summary: As described in the Tongji University notice: tuition, free on-campus housing or an off-campus housing subsidy, a monthly living allowance of RMB 3,000 (master's) or RMB 3,500 (doctoral), and comprehensive medical insurance. International travel is not covered. Support lasts at most 4 years.
teaching_language: Chinese or English (set by the programme)
summary: Master's and doctoral scholarship in marine science, geophysics and related marine-affairs fields for non-Chinese citizens in good health from coastal or island countries bordering the South China Sea, the Indian Ocean or the Pacific, or from African developing countries. Master's applicants need a related bachelor's degree and are usually under 40; doctoral applicants need a related master's and are usually under 45. Master's programmes last 2 to 3 years and doctoral programmes 4. Chinese-taught programmes need HSK 5 with at least 180 points. Applicants apply on the CSC platform (Type B; Tongji's agency number 10247) and on Tongji's own system, and email the listed documents to the contact in the notice. Other host universities publish their own notices.
route_name: CSC platform (Type B) and the host university system
deadline_source_text: 25 October 2025 to 20 December 2025 at Tongji for the 2026 intake; results expected around May 2026. No time or time zone stated. No call for the next intake was found.
